packageRules.description: Patch updates auto-merge; minor updates now require review. Combined with dependabot.yml setting open-pull-requests-limit to 0 for every ecosystem, blanket minor+patch auto-merge made Renovate the sole dependency path into this repository with no human in the loop (F-15). Patch is the narrowest band where unattended merging is defensible.
Never auto-merge inside the trusted computing base, whatever the update type. A patch release of a crypto or transport dependency still changes code that signs receipts and terminates TLS.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security advisories are raised for prompt review, never merged unattended.
